title: Canonical reader browser and runtime hardening

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved exact 20-slice detour, preservation boundary, browser and performance acceptance criteria, rollback units, stop conditions, and predecessor restoration contract.

allowedWork: Instrument and optimize the canonical reader scroll, scheduler, focus, location, responsive-fit, material-owner, compositor-plan, and session-handoff paths.
Add scoped Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browser contracts for measured paint, rapid scroll, native handoff, responsive layout, and WebGL fallback.
Introduce a bounded typed cache for pure measured compositor plans and adjacent idle prewarming; invalidate on every geometry authority field.
disallowedWork: Do not change mathematical semantics, operation plans, established motif choreography, fold truth, accessibility, or static export behavior.
Do not create a second compositor, renderer lifecycle, scheduler, or cache mounted DOM, canvas, WebGL, or accessibility ownership.
Do not generalize beyond the canonical fraction reader before its promotion gates pass or add browser-specific motif patches.
goal: Make the canonical fraction reader responsive under rapid bidirectional scrolling and establish WebKit as a measured-paint and resource-lifecycle contract, then restore the stored role-plan run at slice 14.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice with exact Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if mathematical truth, motif choreography, fold truth, accessibility, native endpoint authority, review capture, or static export changes.
Stop if work requires a second compositor, renderer lifecycle, scheduler, or caching mounted DOM, canvas, WebGL, or accessibility ownership.
Stop if ordinary scroll still performs layout reads or a prepared revisit repeats pure collision compilation after the bounded repair.
Stop if a cross-browser failure can be addressed only with a browser-specific motif or geometry exception.
Stop at slice 19 if automated gates pass but real Safari or subjective motion still requires human judgment; do not restore the predecessor until closure is honest.
